scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client" "npm run dev -w packages/bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client && npm run build -w packages/bot && npm run build -w packages/sim
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/sim
scripts.simulate: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsx packages/sim/src/simulate.ts
scripts.lint: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/bot && tsc -p packages/sim
